thesis: A slow, warm, hypnotic object: wax blobs that merge, stretch, pinch off and sink under a glowing bulb, inside a glass-and-metal lamp you want to stare at.
job: open the page and see a lamp already running, wax already moving
watch blobs rise, merge, stretch, split, cool and sink
turn the lamp on/off (bulb heats and cools; wax stops/starts)
change heat (hotter = faster, bigger rise; cooler = sluggish)
shake/stir or poke wax with the pointer
toggle room light (dark room shows the glow)
see state readouts update (temperature, on/off, blob count)

principles: heat at base, cooling at top
surface tension makes blobs round and merge
steps: model blobs as circles with temperature
heat near bottom, cool near top
tricks: metaball threshold on summed 1/r^2 field gives merge/pinch for free
render field at low res on small canvas and upscale with smoothing
pool of wax at the base as a wide blob row
tests: do they never all stick top or bottom
does it still move after 5 minutes

principles: silhouette of the lamp is the identity
contrast of hot wax vs dark room
tricks: rim light on blobs via field gradient
tests: name it at a glance as a lava lamp
is the lamp shape clearly a rocket/tapered bottle
toggle power and see wax cool and stop
slide heat and see speed change

steps: canvas for lamp, DOM for controls

expectations: wax pools at bottom when cold

kinds.name: classic rocket lamp, orange wax in yellow-ish liquid
kinds.what: tapered glass over a bulb base, red/orange wax, dark room

descriptions: vessel is wide at bottom narrowing up, then slightly shoulder at top
cap is a small dome, base a wide truncated cone
behaviors: blob stretches into a neck then splits

descriptions: hot wax brighter, cooler wax deeper
blobs cross lamp in 12 to 40 seconds
behaviors: power off: temperatures decay, wax sinks and pools
power on: base heats, pooled wax lifts

descriptions: readouts: status text, temperature in C, blob count
behaviors: switch toggles status text to Warming up, Running, Cooling, Off

anti_keywords.instead: true metaball field with merging necks and a hard-ish glossy edge
highlight streaks, cap, base, glow bleeding onto the room
every control changes the sim and a readout
dark room where the lamp is the light

checks: would a stranger say lava lamp at a glance
does power off stop and pool the wax; does power on bring it back
does heat slider change speed and temperature readout
do colour swatches recolour wax and liquid
does it work at phone width with no external requests
built: classic rocket lamp, orange wax in yellow-ish liquid
